lie-mit-18745.title: MIT OpenCourseWare 18.745 (Fall 2020), Lie Groups and Lie Algebras I, lecture notes
lie-mit-18745.notes: Lectures 2-4, 6-11, and 19-26: matrix groups, homogeneous spaces, exponentials, Lie algebras, representations, roots and highest weights.

lie-hall-2015.title: Brian C. Hall, Lie Groups, Lie Algebras, and Representations: An Elementary Introduction, second edition (2015)
lie-hall-2015.notes: Matrix Lie groups, the exponential, basic representation theory, BCH, semisimple Lie algebras and compact Lie groups.

lie-etingof-rep.title: Pavel Etingof, Oleg Golberg, Sebastian Hensel, Tiankai Liu, Alex Schwendner, Dmitry Vaintrob and Elena Yudovina, Introduction to Representation Theory (2011)
lie-etingof-rep.notes: Author-hosted textbook with introductions to groups, representations, Schur's lemma, and Lie-algebra representations.
